summary: Allocates a 64-byte buffer through BufferLockAllocate, copies caller-supplied data (a3, a4, a5) into it, then drives a sequence of vtable-backed property updates on the owning UI object. Conditionally initializes the 0x13C4 state flag to 1 and, at the end, calls the vtable entry at 0x8C when the ready flag at 0x1550 is zero.

If the ready flag at this+0x1550 is zero, invoke vtable entry 136 (offset 0x88) to obtain a handle and store its result at this.

If the ready flag at this+0x1550 is zero, invoke vtable entry 140 (offset 0x8C), store its result at this, and return it.
